A1.justification: Both complete 53-page PDFs describe the same DINOv2 concept-geometry study. The main text, 28 figures, references, and Appendices A–K can be matched without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original concept analyses, perturbation experiments, positional-decoding results, and token-reconstruction comparisons in Sections 3–7 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including task-specific concept findings, positional-removal analyses, and the Archetypal Analysis versus SAE comparison.

M1.justification: Both use the same convex-hull-constrained stable SAE, 32,000-atom dictionary, BatchTopK codes, and linear-probe concept-importance calculation. No algorithm, objective, architecture, or inference component changes.

E1.justification: Figure 2 retains ImageNet-1k classification, ADE20K segmentation, and NYU DepthV2 depth estimation. The ImageNet geometry analyses, perturbation scenarios, and appendix image examples also match.

E2.justification: Figures 9–10 retain the random/shuffled co-activation controls and Random/Grassmannian dictionary baselines. Figure 17 retains Archetypal Analysis versus SAE; no comparator enters or leaves a matched comparison.

E3.justification: Both retain DINOv2-B with four registers, k=8, and 50-epoch Adam training. Section 7.2's ImageNet validation-token, cosine-distance, and k-NN protocol and the appendix perturbation and positional-decoding procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: The same Elsewhere causal masking, five depth-cue perturbations, task-subspace diagnostics, and positional-removal analyses remain. Appendix figures redisplay the same analyses and cases.

E5.justification: Section 5's correlation and significance reporting and Figure 17's shaded bands are retained. No repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty-estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: The reported reconstruction R2 above 88%, Figure 11's r=0.28 and R2=0.08, and Figure 17's reconstruction and interpolation curves match. Appendix perturbation profiles and qualitative findings remain the same despite image re-exporting.

T1.justification: The LRH and MRH definitions, attention and affine-transformation arguments, non-identifiability propositions, and Appendix J proofs are unchanged. Apparent main-text differences result from page and figure breaks.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same dictionary release, task-specific concept families, departures from sparse quasi-orthogonal geometry, and MRH proposal.

C2.justification: Both retain the same mechanism interpretations and conditional steering implications. Appendix J's qualifications that MRH is preliminary, observational, model-specific, and not causal identification are unchanged.

D1.justification: The SAE settings, 8,000-pass RISE procedure, A100 Grassmannian-solver details, visualization optimization instructions, and DinoVision access information are retained in Section 2 and Appendices C, F, and K.

R1.justification: The cited works and bibliography are unchanged, as are the relationships to LRH, convex-geometric precedents, and Gärdenfors' conceptual spaces. Citation-color changes do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: The marginal version/date text changes from v2, 26 February 2026, to v3, 7 May 2026. The prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Existing figures are re-exported at different resolutions, with several dense plots becoming sharper. Citation and cross-reference colors change from orange to green, Figure 17 moves from page 20 to page 21, and surrounding text reflows. All 28 figures and their captions remain.

improvement.justification: Sharper versions of dense plots, especially Figure 18's perturbation panels and Figures 14–15, make small labels and curves easier to inspect. Some PCA image thumbnails are downsampled but remain legible at page scale. The net gain is a limited presentation improvement; scientific content and reproducibility support are unchanged.
